#Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=The map depicts a section of New Haven, Connecticut, focusing on the Yale University campus and its surrounding area.
#Text=Here’s a detailed summary of the map’s content:  Yale University Landmarks:   Yale Old Campus: Located near the center-left of the map, this is a significant part of the Yale campus.

#Text=College Street Music Hall: Found south of the Old Campus, this is a venue for musical performances.
